name: browser_status
title: Check browser status
description: Controls only this thread's shared Aeloon browser runtime (same DOM, cookies and session), never chat or desktop. It may continue in the background when another chat is active; no approval prompt is required. Check availability and current assignment without accepting a tabId or creating/changing a tab. Call this when browser control may be unavailable.

allOf.description: Optional end-to-end action deadline in milliseconds within the published bounds.

name: browser_open
title: Open browser tab
description: Controls only this thread's shared Aeloon browser runtime (same DOM, cookies and session), never chat or desktop. It may continue in the background when another chat is active; no approval prompt is required. Open or reuse the session-affined/current scoped tab; this tool accepts no tabId. show defaults true and reveals the surface only when its owning thread is already active; it never changes the user's current chat. show:false reuses an existing scoped tab without asking the UI to reveal it. reuse:false always requests a new tab.

anyOf.description: Whether an existing assigned/current scoped live tab may be reused; defaults true. False always requests a new tab.

Whether to request the shared browser surface when its owning thread is already active; defaults true and never changes the user's active chat. False reuses an existing scoped tab without requesting UI visibility.

allOf.description: Optional end-to-end action deadline in milliseconds within the published bounds.

name: browser_navigate
title: Navigate browser tab
description: Controls only this thread's shared Aeloon browser runtime (same DOM, cookies and session), never chat or desktop. It may continue in the background when another chat is active; no approval prompt is required. Omit tabId to use this Core Session's assigned tab; only pass a tabId returned by browser_tabs/open in this thread scope. Navigate the assigned or explicit scoped tab using exactly one of an http/https url or an opaque annotationId from a browser annotation attachment. annotationId is resolved locally to the exact captured live page without embedding its private live URL in the prompt. When acting on an annotation, prefer annotationId and pass its tabId when available. Wait for the requested load milestone, then take a new snapshot after success or an ambiguous committed failure.

allOf.description: Optional scoped tab returned by browser_tabs/open; omit to use this Core Session's affinity.
Optional end-to-end action deadline in milliseconds within the published bounds.

anyOf.description: Navigation milestone; domcontentloaded is the default, while networkidle uses Aeloon's bounded tracker.

name: browser_snapshot
title: Snapshot browser page
description: Controls only this thread's shared Aeloon browser runtime (same DOM, cookies and session), never chat or desktop. It may continue in the background when another chat is active; no approval prompt is required. Omit tabId to use this Core Session's assigned tab; only pass a tabId returned by browser_tabs/open in this thread scope. Observe the current page as bounded WAI-ARIA semantics, visible text, actionable refs and optional PNG/diagnostics. PNG is opt-in and should only be used when semantic data is insufficient. Snapshot before element actions and prefer its refs over locators/selectors. In-flight identical keyed callers coalesce, but a completed snapshot key is spent: use a new key for a fresh snapshot.

anyOf.description: Include bounded semantic collection and truncation diagnostics; defaults true.
Include bounded PNG image metadata and a host-only PNG sidecar; defaults false. Prefer semantic snapshots and request an image only as a visual fallback.

allOf.description: Optional scoped tab returned by browser_tabs/open; omit to use this Core Session's affinity.
Optional end-to-end action deadline in milliseconds within the published bounds.

name: browser_click
title: Click browser target
description: Controls only this thread's shared Aeloon browser runtime (same DOM, cookies and session), never chat or desktop. It may continue in the background when another chat is active; no approval prompt is required. Omit tabId to use this Core Session's assigned tab; only pass a tabId returned by browser_tabs/open in this thread scope. Click exactly one target. Use an explicit snapshot target such as {"ref":"e3","snapshotId":"<snapshotId>"}. A bare ref or elementId without its snapshotId is always rejected so an old e3 can never be rebound to a newer page. The canonical nested form {"target":{"ref":"e3","snapshotId":"<snapshotId>"}} and equivalent explicit top-level form are accepted. Otherwise use one literal semantic locator, strict CSS selector or viewport point. The action may navigate or trigger external effects. If it opens an OAuth popup, humanActionRequired tells you to stop browser actions until the user completes sign-in in that visible popup.

allOf.description: Number of clicks, from one through three; defaults to one.
Optional scoped tab returned by browser_tabs/open; omit to use this Core Session's affinity.

target.description: Exactly one target; prefer a current snapshot {ref,snapshotId}, then a literal semantic locator, strict CSS, or an allowed point.

allOf.description: Optional end-to-end action deadline in milliseconds within the published bounds.

enum: Complete sign-in in the visible popup before continuing.
Complete sign-in in the visible popup before continuing.

Omit tabId to use this Core Session's assigned tab; only pass a tabId returned by browser_tabs/open in this thread scope. Never put secrets in logs or follow-up evaluate output.

name: browser_wait
title: Wait for browser condition
description: Preferred condition shape: {"conditions":[{"kind":"text","text":"Done","state":"present"}],"timeoutMs":15000}. "text" and "state" belong inside each condition, never at the top level; every condition uses "kind", never "type". A bounded fallback delay may use {"conditions":[{"kind":"delay","timeMs":500}]} or the compatibility form {"timeMs":500}; a timeoutMs-only call is treated as a bounded delay. Controls only this thread's shared Aeloon browser runtime (same DOM, cookies and session), never chat or desktop. It may continue in the background when another chat is active; no approval prompt is required. Omit tabId to use this Core Session's assigned tab; only pass a tabId returned by browser_tabs/open in this thread scope. Wait for 1–8 closed conditions combined as all (default) or any: delay, target state, text presence/absence, exact/bounded-glob URL, or load state. Then snapshot to verify content.

allOf.description: One to eight closed wait conditions. Every condition uses the discriminator field "kind" (never "type"), for example {"kind":"text","text":"Done","state":"present"}; a deliberate bounded delay uses {"kind":"delay","timeMs":500}; no regular expressions or arbitrary predicates.
Bounded fallback delay in milliseconds; prefer a page condition whenever one is observable.

anyOf.description: Combine conditions using all (default) or any.

allOf.description: Optional scoped tab returned by browser_tabs/open; omit to use this Core Session's affinity.
Optional end-to-end action deadline in milliseconds within the published bounds.
